=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3944 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The merge_with_followup red-check route (`if [ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING:-0}" = "0" ] && [ -s "${RB_JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_NAMES_FILE}" ]; then`) fires on any non-empty names file, but that file comes from the snapshot's failed[] list, which includes cancelled, stale, action_required, startup_failure and non-required/advisory check-runs.
  WHY: A cancelled or advisory-only failure posts `ai:final-ci-repair-request:v1`, the repair returns `repair=none` and uses up the head's attempt, and the next run takes `reason=head_cap`, posts `ai:final-ci-handover:v1`, adds `ai:needs-human` and sends an ERROR alert. This contradicts the branch's own comment ("a cancelled required check blocks; re-run it; non-required/advisory failures are ignored", lines 3897-3905/3955). glm says the same selection flaw applies at 3269-3270 and 3385-3387. Both reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3268-3270, 3385-3387 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merge and terminal routing treats every `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_OUTCOME=failed` as a final-CI repair case, including a required check whose completed conclusion is `cancelled` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:230-231, 1579-1583`; `scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:50, 579-583`).
  WHY: The cancelled check goes to code repair instead of a re-run, which uses up the head's repair attempt, and a later judge run can hand the PR to a person. Rated MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes that the existing `merge` path already uses this classification, so it does not confirm the pass-1 claim as a regression.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3944 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` counts every non-self check-run that is not completed, required or not (pr_checks_lib.sh:661-667). A settled required failure plus one unrelated pending check therefore skips the repair route and keeps `judge_skip_reason=blocking_check_runs`.
  WHY: The PR stalls or waits for stall recovery to re-fire the judge instead of routing to the final-CI repair that #10063 requires. Severity disagreement: minimax says MAJOR, glm says NIT; the highest is used.
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:153-154 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rule says any failed job listed in `CI FAILURES ON THE JUDGED HEAD` stops `merge`/`merge_with_followup`, but the section lists every failed snapshot entry, including advisory/non-required and cancelled ones. The merge gates block only on required-set failures.
  WHY: When the required checks are green and only an advisory check is red, the judge is steered away from `merge` toward `fix` and spends fix rounds on a check the pipeline never required. All three reviewers rate it NIT.
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:153-154 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rule names only `merge` and `merge_with_followup`, but the script also routes the terminal `fix` decision (treated as merge at IS_FINAL) through `rb_judge_route_red_checks terminal` (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3387). README.md:181 documents this as "(or a final fix treated as merge)".
  WHY: A judge may pick `fix` at IS_FINAL thinking it avoids red-check routing, but the workflow still intercepts it and discards the fix plan in favour of the repair request or hand-over. All three reviewers rate it NIT.
- agents.d/10063-red-final-ci-judge-repair.md:10 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contractual registry lists `outcome=handover_already_posted mode=pre_judge|merge|terminal`, but `rb_judge_route_red_checks merge_with_followup` (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3946) can emit `outcome=handover_already_posted mode=merge_with_followup` (review_rb_judge.sh:1936-1938).
  WHY: Log-analysis consumers that match the documented mode enum silently miss this variant, so the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" registry no longer matches the code. The `repair_requested` line was updated but this one was not. All five reviewers rate it NIT.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:~1993 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch-failure withdraw `request_id="$(printf '%s' "${request_id}" | tail -n 1 | tr -cd '0-9')"` keeps whatever digits survive as the DELETE comment id.
  WHY: A multi-line or partial `gh` response with embedded digits could make the DELETE hit an unrelated comment. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "With a required check red on the head, the judge's `merge` is not accepted as the outcome. The run instead takes the final-CI repair path for that head, even when `MAX_AUTOFIX_ITERATIONS` and `MAX_REVIEW_BLOCKED_RETRIES` are used up."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, merge_with_followup blocking-check branch (lines ~3937-3960, route at 3944)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The route runs only when `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING=0`, and that counter counts every non-self, non-completed check-run including unrelated/advisory ones (pr_checks_lib.sh:661-669), so a settled required failure plus a pending unrelated check falls back to `judge_skip_reason=blocking_check_runs` (line 3956). The names file holds every failed/incomplete check-run (cancelled, stale, action_required, non-required), and the branch does not consult the required-only `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_OUTCOME=failed` signal that `merge`/`terminal` use. luna adds that the merge and terminal paths also route only on `failed`, so a required failure next to a check that stays pending until the wait times out never takes the repair path. Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini BLOCKER, minimax MAJOR, luna MAJOR, glm NIT.
- requirement: "Whenever the review-blocked judge runs on a head whose final CI (or any required check) failed, its input contains, per failed job: the job name, the failed step name, and the failing test ids or the last error lines."
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt, the rule for the `CI FAILURES ON THE JUDGED HEAD` section
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The rule names `merge` and `merge_with_followup` but not the terminal `fix` outcome, which is also routed through `rb_judge_route_red_checks terminal`. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt:line 153 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rule says any failed job in `CI FAILURES ON THE JUDGED HEAD` stops the merge, but render_review_rb_ci_failures_file builds that section from every failed[i] entry in PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE (collect_pr_check_runs_context.py FAILURE_CONCLUSIONS, line 50), with no filter to required checks. `_pr_checks_completed` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 637-643) blocks only on required-set failures.
  WHY: When the required checks are green and an advisory check is permanently red, the judge is pushed toward `fix` and spends rounds on a check that was never required. Suggested fix: say "required check-runs", or label the section as covering all failed check-runs.
- agents.d/10063-red-final-ci-judge-repair.md:line 10 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `outcome=handover_already_posted mode=pre_judge|merge|terminal` omits `merge_with_followup`, which `rb_judge_red_check_log handover_already_posted "mode=${mode}"` emits after the new call at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh line 3946.
  WHY: The contractual registry no longer matches the emitter, so log consumers miss the line. Suggested fix: add `|merge_with_followup`.
- Rejected pass-1 MAJOR (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:3940-3953, cancelled required check routed to repair): the new branch matches the `merge` path semantics (`_pr_checks_wait`, pr_checks_lib.sh lines 1579-1583, 1524-1527). Only the old warning text is stale.
- TASK GAP: NONE. The pass-1 gap about pending checks was rejected as existing wait semantics (pr_checks_lib.sh line 1580); stall recovery re-fires the judge.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh rb_judge_route_red_checks withdraw branch `request_id="$(printf '%s' "${request_id}" | tail -n 1 | tr -cd '0-9')"`. Suggestion: accept only a line matching `^[0-9]+$`, otherwise clear it (2-3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
